A-top-bar.dc.html.title: A – Top bar and side panel

F-right-panel.dc.html.title: F – Reading panel on the right

n0.text: A – Top bar and side panel. Closest to Chrome: one bar across the top, thumbnails or contents in a panel on the left that pushes the pages over. Phone: the panel opens as a sheet.

n1.text: B – Floating dock. Pages use the whole window; one pill of controls floats at the bottom and fades while you scroll. Contents open as a card over the pages.

n2.text: C – Tool rail. A slim icon rail on the left opens one panel at a time; find lists every match with its sentence. Phone: the rail becomes a bottom tab bar.

n3.text: D – Page scrubber. No sidebar: drag the handle on the right edge and a preview shows the page and its section. Zoom floats bottom right.

n4.text: E – One box. A single field finds text, jumps to a page number or a section. A strip of page thumbnails runs along the bottom.

n5.text: F – Reading panel on the right. Find, contents and pages share one panel on the right, open by default on wide screens. Phone: a bottom sheet.
